allow: Salesforce Read-Only: `sf org list`, `sf data query`, `sf project retrieve start`, `sf project deploy start --dry-run`, and `sf apex run test` against the default `asoc` org are allowed.
Salesforce Deploy to Dev Org: `sf project deploy start` to the default `asoc` org is allowed when the user asked for a deploy (e.g. via /deploy).
soft_deny: Salesforce Production Deploy: Deploying to, or running `sf data` write/delete or anonymous Apex against, any org other than the default `asoc` org or any org marked production.
Salesforce Data Deletion: `sf data delete`, `sf data bulk delete`, or Apex that runs DML delete/purge on org data.
environment: Salesforce: the default target org alias `asoc` is a development org. Any org whose alias, username, or instance name contains `prod` or `production` is a production target.
Salesforce CLI (`sf`) is the org-specific CLI for deploys, retrieves, Apex runs, and data queries
